appSource.buildNote: Signed root universal APK built from the committed app source at appSource.commit.
appSource.releaseNote: This Actions candidate embeds the default root build; the app workflow also provides a signed libxposed API 102 variant.

notes: This Actions candidate packages signed root universal app 1.7.2/code 147 from bac41d025ed4dfde4014844d10ae784a156741b4, without changing any published release.

The ARM64 driver and ldspctl helper are unchanged from stable 6.7.1, including their Android 16/API 36 minimum. Native compatibility for earlier Android versions remains planned and is not part of this beta.
Work-profile routing, Samsung SystemUI panel reliability, SBC Bluetooth distortion in Fusion and late-mounted audio APEX behavior in temp-root remain under investigation before stable 6.7.2.
